page.overview:
What is Priori Incantatem?

Prior Incantato, was a charm that forced a wand to show an "echo" of the last spell it had performed. Its counter-charm was the Eradication Spell, which removed these images.

Priori Incantatem, otherwise known as the "reverse spell effect", was an especially rare manifestation of this spell that occurred when two wands with the same core (that is, taken from the same exact specimen of animal) attempted to duel each other. The winner's wand forced the loser's wand to produce "echoes" of the most recent spells performed in reverse order.

When cast, the wand in question would be forced to produce an image of the last spell it cast. The spell could be cast multiple times to cycle through the history of a wand's use, and it was for this reason that criminals would often borrow another's wand in order to commit crimes, as, if they were to use their own wand, it could be traced back to them.

Despite this forensic usefulness, however, the spell could only reveal what magic the wand had recently done and not who had actually performed said magic; the examinations of the wands of Morfin Gaunt and Harry Potter both proved they had cast the suspected dark spells (Avada Kedavra and Morsmordre, respectively), but not that they had been cast by the accused parties, Morfin Gaunt and Winky, meaning that if a wand was stolen, used in a criminal act and then returned it could lead to the wand's owner being falsely accused and even imprisoned.
